name: diabloarb_executor
description: DiabloArb arbitrage executor: finds and executes the most profitable route over the listed swap windows at execution time, with an optional flash loan from the DiabloArb vault. Raw little-endian byte layout (NOT Anchor/Borsh: list lengths are u8 counters in the header). Field-by-field explanation: README.md.
encoding: little-endian; u8/u16/u32/u64 unsigned, i64 signed; no padding; no length prefixes except the u8 counters named in each header

Hop.description: A swap window: which DEX, the direction and where its accounts are in the instruction's account list.

fields.name: first
fields.description: index of the DEX program in the instruction accounts; the swap accounts follow it

fields.name: len
fields.description: number of swap accounts after the program: accounts[first+1 .. first+1+len]

fields.name: out
fields.description: index of the user's token account that receives this hop's output

Base.description: A token routes start and end in (SOL as WSOL, USDC, USDT). Base b is the user's token account at account index 1+b.

fields.name: weight
fields.description: value of one base unit in lamports, Q32 (WSOL: 1<<32; USDC at 150 USD/SOL: ~6.667 lamports per micro-USDC => 6.667*2^32). Profits of different bases compare by profit*weight>>32

fields.name: start
fields.description: opening trade size of the on-chain search, base units (small, e.g. 0.001 SOL); with HINT in rounds: an estimate of the optimum

fields.name: max_in
fields.description: cap on the trade size, base units; the program also caps by user balance (+ vault balance with the vault section). Use u64::MAX/4 for no cap of yours

fields.name: base
fields.description: base index (< n_bases): the route starts and ends in this token

fields.name: windows
fields.description: indexes into the window table, in swap order

Dex.name: RaydiumClmm
Dex.note: Raydium CLMM and its fork PancakeSwap CLMM

Dex.name: ByrealClmm
Dex.note: Raydium CLMM accounts and swap_v2, Byreal fee rules

Dex.name: TokenSwap
Dex.note: SPL Token Swap and Orca v2

HopFlags.name: A_TO_B
HopFlags.description: swap token A -> token B of the pool (A/B as the DEX names them; see README per DEX)

HopFlags.name: LEGACY
HopFlags.description: Whirlpool / Raydium CLMM (+forks) / DLMM: the older `swap` instruction and its account list (classic SPL Token mints only)

SearchFlags.name: FAIL_WHEN_DRY
SearchFlags.description: no route reaches min_profit: fail with NoProfit (7) instead of succeeding as a no-op

SearchFlags.name: VAULT
SearchFlags.description: a vault section follows the base accounts: flash loan + fee destination. REQUIRED for every signer but the program owner

SearchFlags.name: BUDGET
SearchFlags.description: the last 4 bytes of data are a u32 compute-unit budget (the transaction's CU limit minus CU spent before this instruction); the search stops so the best route still executes within it

data.name: rounds
data.description: search precision: stop within best/2^(8+rounds) of the bound; bit7 (0x80) = HINT: Base.start is an estimate of the optimum. 0 is a good default

data.name: min_profit
data.description: lamports of value (profit*weight>>32) the best route must reach, after the 7% fee; else NoProfit / no-op

accounts.name: user
accounts.description: the trader; pays the fee to the vault

accounts.name: base_token_accounts
accounts.description: the user's SPL Token accounts of each base mint, in base order (must exist, may hold 0 with the vault section)

accounts.name: vault_token_accounts
accounts.description: one per base, same order: the vault's token account of that base mint (owner = vault PDA)

accounts.name: hop windows
accounts.description: for every window: the DEX program, then its swap accounts (README section per DEX); the user's intermediate token accounts referenced by Hop.out may sit anywhere in the list. Windows shared by several routes are listed once

return_data.name: route
return_data.description: index of the executed route; 255 = none reached min_profit (no-op)

instructions.name: quote
instructions.description: One on-chain quote of one hop; changes nothing. For measuring/testing.

accounts.name: the hop's window (program + swap accounts) at Hop.first

instructions.name: route
instructions.description: Owner only: run one route at a fixed amount.

instructions.name: withdraw
instructions.description: Owner only: move tokens out of the vault.

errors.name: InvalidData
errors.description: malformed data: counts out of range, lengths do not add up, unknown tag

errors.name: AccountIndex
errors.description: an index points past the account list

errors.name: Unprofitable
errors.description: the executed route did not realize the expected profit (state moved between search and execution, or after the fee below min_profit)

errors.name: NotTokenAccount
errors.description: a base / out account is not a token account

errors.name: NoProfit
errors.description: no route reached min_profit and FAIL_WHEN_DRY is set (normal: the opportunity is gone)

errors.name: BadVault
errors.description: vault section accounts wrong (PDA, token program, vault account of another mint/owner) or the vault not repaid

errors.name: NotOwner
errors.description: owner-only tag, or a search without the vault section by anyone but the owner
